design: selection-60, n=3 eps/phrase, CRN, all applies WITH traces (redo of trace-less 2026-09-01 run)
verdict: With full traces the no-rules scaffold beats both distilled rulebooks by ~6pp (vs a three-way tie in the trace-less run): scaffold-it3 CI touches 0, scaffold-challenger CI spans 0, so 'rulebooks provide no gain over fable instincts and trend harmful' is the supported claim.
